policies.title: Contoso Vacation (Paid Time Off) Policy
policies.text: Full-time employees accrue 15 days of paid vacation per calendar year (1.25 days per month). After 5 years of service, accrual increases to 20 days per year. Vacation requests of 3 or more consecutive days must be submitted to your manager at least 10 business days in advance. Up to 5 unused days may be carried over into the next calendar year; any additional unused days are forfeited on December 31. Unused vacation is not paid out except where required by local law.

policies.title: Contoso Company Holiday Policy
policies.text: Contoso observes 10 paid company holidays per year: New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, the day after Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, and Christmas Day. Each employee also receives 2 floating holidays per year, which must be used within the calendar year and cannot be carried over. Employees required to work on a company holiday receive an alternate day off within 30 days.
